title: Automatic Scope Cleanup
goal: Ensure state is reset on function exit without duplicating manual cleanup code.
hints: Look at how each candidate manages restoring or clearing state.
RAII uses destructors to reset state automatically without making extra clones.
explanation: The `Guard` struct implements `Drop` to clear `data` as soon as `_guard` leaves scope. This avoids cloning values entirely and guarantees cleanup even if the function exits early or panics.
